sources.name: Natural Earth 10m rivers and lake centerlines
Natural Earth 10m rivers, North America supplement

provenance.licence: All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain. TIGER/Line shapefiles are US Government work, public domain.
provenance.edgeRule: one passable movement edge per undirected geographic adjacency edge (shared boundary segment; corner-only contacts excluded)
provenance.crossingRule: shared boundary = segments owned by both counties; pieces no longer than the tolerance count toward a river when their midpoint is within 0.02 degrees of the river's lines; Natural Earth tags the highest length fraction when it is >= 0.5; TIGER/Line 2023 linear and area water named features containing "River" (Lake/Reservoir/Creek/Branch-only names excluded; area-water polygon ring edges count as lines) tag when their highest length fraction is >= 0.5, where a TIGER segment counts fully only when both endpoints are within the tolerance of the same river; an edge is tagged if either source tags it; the label is the TIGER name without a trailing " River" when TIGER tags it, otherwise the Natural Earth name; each source's best river and fraction is recorded when >= 0.3

provenance.riverAssumption: river courses treated as stable since 1942; centerlines and named river area-water polygons only, reservoirs ignored

sanity.note: informational, not a pass/fail check: state-border river stretches are not internal edges, so internal tags on these rivers are listed for review
